Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Today feels like a good day."

[It starts to rain.]

Rishabh (excited): "I knew it!"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Rishabh (happily): "Mom, look at this."

[Snow begins to fall.]

Rishabh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
